title: 7 out of 10 'multicultural' marriages in Korea involve foreign wives
caption:
New government data reveals a major demographic trend in South Korea. Over 70 percent of multicultural marriages involve a foreign wife, with a significant age gap between spouses.

Source: Koreaherald - 7 out of 10 'multicultural' marriages in Korea involve foreign wives
